title: Theorems 1.6 and 1.9: rectifiability iff approximate tangent spaces exist a.e. (unweighted and weighted)
statement: (Theorem 1.6) For all n, ℓ and every Hⁿ-measurable M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K: M is countably n-rectifiable iff for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there is a subspace P with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x P (Simon Definition 1.4: finrank P = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f dHⁿ → ∫_P f dHⁿ as r ↓ 0 for all f ∈ C_c). (Theorem 1.9) For all n, ℓ, every Hⁿ-measurable M ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} and every positive locally integrable weight θ on M: M is countably n-rectifiable iff for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M there is P with HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x P (Definition 1.7: finrank P = n and ∫_{η_{x,r}(M)} f(y)θ(x + ry) dHⁿ(y) → θ(x)∫_P f dHⁿ for all f ∈ C_c).
